format: html
---

penguins <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/allisonhorst/palmerpenguins/main/inst/extdata/penguins.csv")

```
ggplot(penguins, aes(
    x = flipper_length_mm,
    y = body_mass_g
  )) +
    geom_point(color = "steelblue") +
    labs(
      title = "Quantitative + Quantitative",
      x = "Flipper Length (mm)",
      y = "Body Mass (g)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
```
